verdict.rationale: First-party docs state Bevy is free and open-source forever under the permissive MIT or Apache 2.0 licenses, with no contracts, no license fees and no sales cuts. A runtime crates.io probe independently confirms the 'MIT OR Apache-2.0' license, and community comments praise the no-strings MIT licensing. Every element of the story (permissive license, no royalties, no per-install fees) is covered.
